title: Soodles: Test Cost, Schema Projection and Repair Boundaries
summary_zh: 28 個模組、617 個案例的正常 CI 成本審視；已回饋 Schema Manager，區分毫秒級狀態投影、測試必要性與尚未完成的自動修復閉環。

dimensions.name: Engineering judgment
dimensions.reason: Preserve nine distinct refusal boundaries; do not infer redundancy from duration.

dimensions.name: Debugging quality
dimensions.reason: Fixture and caller trace examined; no implementer debugging transcript.

dimensions.name: Reasoning clarity
dimensions.reason: Concrete conditions and falsifiers retained; independent expert agreement unknown.

dimensions.name: Architectural thinking
dimensions.reason: Cost review, typed projection and original repair ownership traced.

dimensions.name: Communication
dimensions.reason: English mechanism review and Chinese guide; reader outcomes unknown.

dimensions.name: Attention to detail
dimensions.reason: Eight local API expectations matched; worker and wall costs remain distinct.

dimensions.name: Developer trust
dimensions.reason: No false repair, test deletion, full lifecycle or human qualification claim.

limits: Log files retain decoded GitHub connector text with terminal newline normalized, not original transport bytes.
Selected manager source is pinned to the merge revision; CI evidence belongs to the explicitly separate PR candidate.
No complete coding-agent transcript or human judgment.
Known historical inputs and source-informed prediction are excluded from general prediction metrics.
Original atom authorization/checkpoint/current typed owner result absent
Per-case necessity and causal cost reduction unverified
Decision-barrier, token and whole-lifecycle costs unmeasured
No future-agent forecast, human judgment or repair-effectiveness observation
capture_scope: Pinned source and historical CI; Soodles implementer decisions are not captured.
